name: LetterPress AI – Beautiful Transactional Email, AI E-Mail Builder, Email Marketing, Visual Email Builder, SMTP, Newsletter & Multi-Brand Campaign
author: BriskFoundry

sections.description:
Every email your website sends should represent your brand.

From newsletters and marketing campaigns to WooCommerce notifications, password resets, and everyday WordPress emails, make every message look beautiful and professional.

Meet LetterPress, the all-in-one email solution for WordPress. Create stunning emails with an intuitive visual builder, generate email designs and copy with AI, customize transactional emails across your favorite WordPress plugins, and manage email delivery, all from one place.

No more plain, forgettable system emails. No more separate plugins for email delivery, marketing, and design. Just one powerful solution to create, customize, and deliver every WordPress email.

Get LetterPress AI Pro | Documentation

Three powerful solutions. One plugin.

  • Beautiful Transactional Emails: Design professional emails using a visual email builder. No HTML, CSS, or PHP required.
  • Email Marketing: Manage subscribers, create newsletters, and send targeted email campaigns directly from WordPress.
  • SMTP & Email Delivery: Connect your preferred email provider and deliver your website’s outgoing emails.

Beautiful Transactional Emails Without Coding

Your website sends important emails every day. Password resets, user registrations, account notifications, and more.

But most WordPress emails look plain, outdated, and disconnected from your brand.

LetterPress changes that.

Use the visual, block-based email builder to create professional transactional emails that match your brand. Design, customize, and preview your emails without writing a single line of HTML or PHP.

Powerful email design features:

  • Visual Email Builder: Create emails using an intuitive block-based editor.
  • Ready-Made Templates: Start with professionally designed templates instead of a blank canvas.
  • Flexible Layouts: Build emails using rows, columns, sections, and content blocks.
  • Rich Design Controls: Customize typography, colors, backgrounds, spacing, borders, and more.
  • Desktop & Mobile Preview: Preview your designs across desktop and mobile layouts.
  • Dynamic Variables: Personalize emails using supported variables such as names and site information.
  • Reusable Templates: Save, duplicate, and reuse your email designs.
  • Live Preview: See how your emails look before publishing.

Customize WordPress emails

Take control of your website’s default notification emails, including:

  • New user registration.
  • Password reset.
  • Account changes.
  • Comment notifications.
  • Subscription confirmation.
  • Other supported WordPress notifications.

Stop sending plain, generic emails. Give your website’s notifications a consistent, professional look.

WooCommerce and other plugin integrations are available in LetterPress Pro.

Email Marketing & Newsletter Campaigns

Need an email marketing platform without expensive monthly subscriptions?

LetterPress brings email marketing directly into your WordPress dashboard. Build your audience, create campaigns, and send newsletters using your preferred email delivery provider.

Everything you need to manage email marketing:

  • Campaign Builder: Create engaging emails with titles, messages, buttons, content, and footers.
  • Subscriber Management: Collect, organize, and manage subscribers.
  • Groups & Sources: Segment your audience by group, website, signup form, or brand.
  • Personalization: Use merge tags such as {{name}} to personalize campaigns.
  • Campaign Scheduling: Schedule campaigns for future delivery.
  • Campaign Reports: Review campaign progress and sending reports.
  • Test Emails: Test your emails before sending them to your audience.
  • Double Opt-in: Verify subscriber email addresses before adding them to your confirmed audience.
  • CSV Import & Export: Easily migrate and manage subscriber lists.
  • Multiple Brands: Manage subscribers and sender identities for different websites and brands.
  • Unsubscribe Management: Provide personalized unsubscribe links and List-Unsubscribe headers.

Whether you’re sending weekly newsletters, product announcements, or business updates, LetterPress gives you the tools to manage your email marketing directly from WordPress.

SMTP & Reliable WordPress Email Delivery

Only need an SMTP plugin? LetterPress has you covered too.

You don’t need to use email marketing features to benefit from LetterPress. Use it purely as an SMTP solution to improve how your WordPress website sends emails.

  • Configure SMTP with your host, port, encryption, and credentials.
  • Connect popular transactional email delivery providers.
  • Route WordPress emails through your selected provider.
  • Replace your existing SMTP plugin.
  • Test provider connections and authentication.
  • Protect stored provider credentials with encryption.

From password reset links and user notifications to contact form submissions, LetterPress can handle your website’s outgoing emails.

Use SMTP independently without ever creating a newsletter or marketing campaign.

Powerful Email Delivery Integrations

Choose the email delivery provider that works best for your website.

LetterPress supports:

  • Amazon SES
  • SendGrid
  • Mailjet
  • Mailgun
  • Postmark
  • Brevo
  • Resend
  • SparkPost
  • MailerSend
  • Mandrill (Mailchimp Transactional Email)
  • SMTP2GO
  • Zoho ZeptoMail
  • Generic SMTP
  • WordPress mail (wp_mail())

Only your selected provider is used to send emails. Other provider configurations are retained if you decide to switch later.

Save money with Amazon SES

Why pay expensive monthly email marketing delivery rates when you can send through Amazon SES?

Amazon SES charges approximately $0.10 per 1,000 outbound emails. At higher volumes, the savings can be substantial.

Send more. Spend less. Keep control of your email infrastructure.

Estimates use Amazon SES at $0.10 per 1,000 emails and example SaaS delivery rates. They compare delivery costs only, not equivalent feature sets or full subscription costs. Actual pricing depends on provider, region, plan, and usage. Additional charges may apply.

Unlock More with LetterPress Pro

More integrations. More templates. AI-powered email design.

LetterPress Pro takes your email workflow further with integrations for popular WordPress plugins, an expanded library of professionally designed email templates, and an AI-powered email builder.

1. Integrate Your Favorite WordPress Plugins

Your website relies on different plugins to run your business. Each one sends important notifications to customers, students, members, or administrators.

LetterPress Pro brings these notifications into one email customization platform. Customize supported transactional emails using the same visual email builder.

eCommerce

  • WooCommerce (27 email events)
  • Easy Digital Downloads (EDD)

Learning Management Systems

  • LearnDash
  • Tutor LMS

Membership & Subscriptions

  • MemberPress
  • Paid Memberships Pro

Forms & Lead Generation

  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Gravity Forms
  • Fluent Forms
  • Divi (theme contact form)

Booking & Appointments

  • Amelia
  • Bookly

From order confirmations and payment notifications to course updates, membership emails, form submissions, and booking confirmations, customize your supported plugin emails without editing their code.

2. 50+ Professionally Designed Ready Made Email Template Library

Don’t start with a blank canvas. Choose from a larger collection of professionally designed email templates for different industries, businesses, and communication purposes.

Find ready-made designs for:

  • eCommerce and order notifications.
  • Business announcements.
  • Newsletters and marketing campaigns.
  • Product launches and promotions.
  • Customer onboarding and welcome emails.
  • Membership and subscription notifications.
  • Educational and LMS notifications.
  • Booking and appointment confirmations.
  • Payment and invoice notifications.
  • Business updates and more.

Import a template, customize its content, add your branding, and make it yours.

Explore LetterPress Pro to discover all premium features and templates.

3. AI Email Builder

Have an idea for an email? Simply describe it.

LetterPress Pro includes an AI-powered email builder that helps you generate email designs using simple text prompts.

For example:

  • “Create a professional order confirmation email for an online fashion store.”
  • “Design a welcome email for new members of my fitness website.”
  • “Create a modern weekly newsletter with three featured articles.”
  • “Build a course completion email with a certificate announcement.”
  • “Design a booking confirmation email for a premium hotel.”

Describe what you want, let AI generate the design, and customize it further using the visual email builder.

No need to understand email HTML or spend hours arranging blocks.

Your ideas. AI-powered design. Complete creative control.

4. Email Tracking & Performance Analytics

We’re planning to bring more email analytics and performance insights to LetterPress Pro.

Future enhancements will include email tracking and campaign performance reports to help you better understand how your emails perform.

These analytics features are planned for future Pro releases and are not currently available.

Ready to get more from your WordPress emails?

Explore LetterPress Pro and take your email customization to the next level.

Built for Reliable Email Delivery

Sending emails is only part of the job. LetterPress includes queue management and delivery controls to help you handle campaigns responsibly.

  • Resumable campaign queues.
  • Configurable sending limits and daily quotas.
  • Independent worker batch size.
  • Automatic retries with backoff for eligible failures.
  • Protection against duplicate sends.
  • WordPress cron and server scheduler support.
  • Amazon SES quota reporting.
  • Delivery, bounce, complaint, and rejection event tracking through Amazon SNS.

Actual sending speed depends on your provider’s quotas, server resources, scheduler configuration, network conditions, and retries.

Multiple Brands, One Dashboard

Manage different websites, brands, and signup forms without maintaining separate subscriber management systems.

Each signup source can have its own:

  • Display name and website.
  • Sender name and email address.
  • Reply-To address.
  • Double opt-in confirmation email.
  • Subscriber audience.

Filter subscribers by source and send campaigns to a particular brand or audience.

Developer-Friendly REST API

Need to connect another application or build a custom integration?

LetterPress includes a REST API for managing subscribers programmatically.

  • Create and manage API keys.
  • Add subscribers through the REST API.
  • Retrieve paginated subscriber lists.
  • Filter subscribers by source.
  • Authenticate requests using Bearer tokens.
  • Revoke API keys whenever needed.

API keys are stored as hashes and shown in full only when created.

Why LetterPress?

You don’t need separate plugins for SMTP, email marketing, and transactional email design.

LetterPress brings everything together in one place:

  • SMTP & Email Delivery: Configure SMTP and connect popular email delivery providers.
  • Email Marketing: Create email campaigns and newsletters directly from WordPress.
  • Subscriber Management: Manage subscribers, groups, and signup sources.
  • Visual Email Builder: Customize supported WordPress emails without coding.
  • Professional Email Templates: Start with ready-made designs and customize them for your brand.
  • Reliable Email Delivery: Manage queues, sending limits, automatic retries, and delivery events.
  • Multiple Brands: Manage different audiences and sender identities from one dashboard.
  • Developer-Friendly REST API: Connect external applications and manage subscribers programmatically.

One plugin. Complete control over your WordPress emails.

Privacy

LetterPress stores subscriber information and campaign data in your WordPress database.

When sending campaigns, transactional messages, test emails, or WordPress email routed through the optional site-wide delivery setting, the selected provider receives the recipient address, sender details, subject, message content, and required email headers.

Provider credentials are used to authenticate requests. Providers may also process delivery events such as bounces, complaints, opens, or clicks when event tracking is configured.

Amazon SES event tracking uses an HTTPS endpoint for SNS notifications. Event data can include recipient addresses, message identifiers, and delivery or bounce details.

LetterPress also supports personalized unsubscribe links, List-Unsubscribe headers, and suppression lists to help manage subscriber preferences.

Email and privacy requirements vary by location and use case. Using LetterPress does not by itself guarantee legal compliance.
sections.installation:
1. Install LetterPress through the WordPress Plugins screen or upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/letterpress.
  2. Activate LetterPress.
  3. Go to LetterPress > Settings and select your delivery provider.
  4. Configure your sender identity and sending limits.
  5. Test your provider connection and send a test email.
  6. Open the email template builder to customize supported WordPress notification emails.
  7. Add [letterpress_signup] to a page to display a signup form.
  8. Configure double opt-in if you want subscribers to confirm their addresses.
  9. Open LetterPress > Cron Setup and follow the instructions for your hosting environment.

For reliable campaign processing, configure a server scheduler to request the displayed WordPress cron URL every minute.
sections.faq:
What is LetterPress?

LetterPress is an all-in-one WordPress email solution combining SMTP delivery, email marketing, newsletter management, and visual transactional email customization.

Is LetterPress an SMTP plugin?

Yes. LetterPress works as a standalone SMTP plugin. Configure your preferred SMTP server or email delivery provider and route your WordPress emails through it. Campaigns and newsletters are optional.

Can I customize transactional emails without coding?

Yes. LetterPress includes a visual, block-based email builder. You can customize supported WordPress notification emails using layouts, text, images, buttons, and styling controls without writing HTML or PHP.

Is the visual email builder available in the free version?

Yes, The visual email builder is included in the free version. You can design and customize supported WordPress email templates without purchasing Pro.

Does the free version support WooCommerce email customization?

WooCommerce integration is available in LetterPress Pro. Pro supports 27 WooCommerce email events, covering customer notifications and administrator emails.

Which integrations are included in LetterPress Pro?

LetterPress Pro includes integrations for WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads, LearnDash, Tutor LMS, MemberPress, Paid Memberships Pro, Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Divi, Amelia, and Bookly.

What additional features does LetterPress Pro offer?

LetterPress Pro includes:

  • Integrations with popular WordPress plugins.
  • An expanded library of professional email templates.
  • AI-powered email generation using simple text prompts.
  • Additional email customization capabilities.

Email tracking and advanced campaign performance reports are planned for future releases.

Can I use ready-made email templates?

Yes. LetterPress includes templates to help you get started. Pro provides a much larger collection of professionally designed templates for different industries and email purposes.

Does LetterPress support AI email generation?

Yes. LetterPress Pro includes an AI-powered email builder. Describe the email you want using a simple text prompt, and AI helps generate the design for further customization.

Which email delivery providers does LetterPress support?

LetterPress supports Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mailjet, Mailgun, Postmark, Brevo, Resend, SparkPost, MailerSend, Mandrill, SMTP2GO, and ZeptoMail through their APIs, plus generic SMTP and standard WordPress mail.

Can I replace my existing SMTP plugin?

Yes. LetterPress can handle your website’s outgoing WordPress emails through a configured SMTP server or supported API provider.

Can I schedule an email campaign?

Yes. You can schedule campaigns for a future date and time. LetterPress starts them when the scheduled time arrives, provided WordPress cron or your server scheduler is running.

Can I test an email before sending it?

Yes. You can send test emails to verify your content and email delivery before sending a campaign.

Can I personalize emails?

Yes. Use supported merge tags such as {{name}} in your campaign subject or message body. If a subscriber does not have a name, LetterPress uses “there” as the fallback.

Can subscribers unsubscribe?

Yes. Campaigns include personalized unsubscribe links and List-Unsubscribe headers. Unsubscribed, blocked, and suppressed addresses are excluded from future campaigns.

Can I manage multiple brands or signup forms?

Yes. Create different sources for websites, forms, or brands. Each source can have its own sender identity and double opt-in message.

Can I import existing contacts?

Yes. Import subscribers from CSV files or import existing WordPress users. You can also export subscriber data to CSV.

Can I connect LetterPress to another application?

Yes. The REST API lets authenticated applications add subscribers and retrieve a paginated list of subscribed addresses.

Does LetterPress guarantee email delivery or legal compliance?

No plugin can guarantee inbox placement or legal compliance on its own. You are responsible for collecting appropriate consent, following applicable laws, configuring your sending provider and DNS records, and maintaining your subscriber list.

Found a bug or need help?

If you find a bug, have a question, or need help with LetterPress, please contact our team. You can also visit Themeqx to learn more about our products.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Fixed email styles being corrupted during sanitization. Quoted font stacks no longer break font size, font weight, line height, text color or alignment in previews and sent campaigns.

1.0.0

  • Added drag-and-drop Visual Email Builder.
  • Added AI-powered Email Builder.
  • Added transactional email customization.
  • Added SMTP integration and Amazon SES support.
  • Added subscriber group and source-based campaign targeting.
  • Improved email delivery performance and reliability.
  • Completely revamped the plugin with a redesigned interface and improved architecture.

Email Marketing Dashboard - Monitor your email marketing performance with a clear dashboard showing subscribers, campaigns, sending activity, delivery rates, bounces, and open rates.
Preview Emails Before Sending - Preview your emails before sending to see exactly how they will look to recipients. Check your design and send test emails directly from the preview window.
Customize WooCommerce Emails - Customize WooCommerce transactional emails with beautiful, consistent designs. Personalize order notifications, customer emails, and admin messages to match your brand.
Customize Emails Across WordPress Integrations - Bring a consistent branded design to emails from popular WordPress plugins, including LMS, membership, form, booking, and eCommerce integrations.

Beautiful WordPress Transactional Emails - Transform default WordPress emails into beautifully branded notifications. Customize registration, password reset, comment notifications, and other system emails.
